messages:
Wei: Quick thread — I'm doing a lightweight refresh of the 'Hello Orchard' quickstart. Scope: canonicalize env var, add a minimal Python example (sync + async streaming), fix a broken anchor to /deploy/production#regions, and call out node/python versions.
Hannah: SGTM. Which env var are we standardizing on? REDWOOD_API_KEY is all over the repo.
Wei: Proposal: RWD_API_KEY as the canonical name (short for Redwood). Will include a migration note and a tiny helper script to grab REDWOOD_API_KEY if present.
Omar: I ran the sample and hit a 401 in docker because the compose file reads .env but the README referenced REDWOOD_API_KEY. Easy mismatch. I'll update docker-compose and samples/.env.example.
Zoe: For Python examples, please include both requests-style sync and an async iterator streaming example using our python SDK. Keep both under 15 lines each.
Wei: Draft async streaming snippet for Python (will be tightened):
```py
# stream_example.py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('RWD_API_KEY'))
async for chunk in client.stream_generate(model='orchard-tiny', prompt='Say hi'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Hannah: Nice. Also add a sync example to show absolute minimal call for copy-paste newcomers: 
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RWD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='orchard-tiny', prompt='Hello')
print(resp.text)
```
Omar: CI-Bot flagged the samples matrix: builds run on ubuntu:20 with python 3.8 image; streaming SDK needs 3.10+. I'll update samples/README and CI to require python>=3.10 for sample smoke tests.
Wei: We should also add a Windows/WSL note for docker volume mounts — some folks saw an empty .env when composing on Windows due to path mappings. Add a short fix in README and a powershell snippet.
Zoe: Also add `scripts/migrate-env.py` that copies REDWOOD_API_KEY -> RWD_API_KEY if present, to avoid breaking local devs. Keep it tiny and cross-platform.
Omar: PR created on branch docs/hello-orchard-refresh: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8215. I included a checklist in the PR body: env rename, python snippets, anchor fix, CI change, migrate script, windows note.
Hannah: Pinging DocsBot to run link-check + preview: @DocsBot please run link-check + preview for PR #8215
DocsBot: Link check queued for PR #8215 — running.
CI-Bot: CI started for PR #8215 — running unit tests and sample smoke.
Omar: CI smoke failed on Windows runner with empty .env mount. I added the powershell note and updated docker-compose to support an explicit env_file fallback. Re-running.
DocsBot: Link check passed for PR #8215
CI-Bot: CI now green for linux/macos matrix; windows runner still flaky but sample smoke passes when using the env_file fallback. Marking as flaky ticket.
Wei: Thanks team. Assigning Hannah and Zoe as reviewers. Targeting merge tomorrow AM once Windows runner is stable or we add a short flaky-test exception. Please add :eyes: on the PR and leave comments on any API wording.
Hannah: Reviewing now. Small nits: shorten the streaming python example to avoid long lines and add a one-line token rotation note.
Zoe: LGTM after the tiny wording tweak on the migrate script docs.
Wei: Great — I'll merge after CI is green. Will post here when merged and share the preview URL.
DocsBot: PR #8215 merged and preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/8215
Wei: Merged and preview up. Closing loop — thanks all :tada:
